scripts.dev: concurrently --restart-tries 3 --restart-after 2000 --prefix-colors "blue,cyan,yellow,green,magenta,white,red,gray" -n "hub,dosje,smile,pm-ajay,scw,nmba,docs,storybook" "bash -c 'cd apps/hub && exec ./node_modules/.bin/next dev --turbopack -p 3000'" "bash -c 'cd apps/dosje && exec ./node_modules/.bin/next dev --turbopack -p 3001'" "bash -c 'cd apps/portals/smile-admin && exec ../../../node_modules/.bin/next dev --turbopack -p 4123'" "bash -c 'cd apps/portals/pm-ajay && exec ../../../node_modules/.bin/next dev --turbopack -p 4124'" "bash -c 'cd apps/portals/scw && exec ../../../node_modules/.bin/next dev --turbopack -p 4125'" "bash -c 'cd apps/portals/nmba && exec ../../../node_modules/.bin/next dev --turbopack -p 4126'" "bash -c 'cd apps/docs && exec ../../node_modules/.bin/next dev --turbopack -p 3002'" "bash -c 'cd apps/storybook && exec env NODE_PATH=$(pwd)/node_modules ../../node_modules/.bin/storybook dev -p 6006 --ci'"
scripts.dev:storybook: bash -c 'cd apps/storybook && exec env NODE_PATH=$(pwd)/node_modules ../../node_modules/.bin/storybook dev -p 6006'
